name: dsh-ai-commit
description: AI-generate a git commit message from the current changes, using the DSH host's configured LLM. Adds a sparkle button next to the commit button in the Source Control view.

dsh-ai-commit.bridgeUrl.description: Overridden automatically from the DSH_AI_BRIDGE_URL environment variable; the localhost bridge that runs the LLM.

dsh-ai-commit.openScmOnStart.description: Open the Source Control view when the workbench starts (the embedded workbench reloads fresh on every VS Code tab re-entry).
